section: Women's welfare schemes - Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, Mission Shakti, PMMVY, Ujjwala
subsections: Shelter, livelihood and income schemes - target group

accepted.s: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, introduced in 2015 under Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao, is associated with which of the following?
o: An annual pension for women above 60 years of age
Vocational training for adolescent girls in aspirational districts
A post-birth grant exclusively for girls of BPL families
A small-savings account for a girl below 10 years of age for education and marriage
accepted.x: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was introduced in 2015 under BBBP as a small-savings account scheme for girls below 10 years, primarily supporting education and marriage expenses.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the precise objective of a scheme from the objectives of nearby girl-child programmes.

accepted.s: Balika Samriddhi Yojana, launched in 1997, provides which of the following benefits?
o: A savings account for girls below 10 years of age
Post-birth grants and annual scholarships for girls belonging to BPL families
Nutrition and life-skills training for adolescent girls under ICDS
Conditional cash transfers for immunisation and delayed marriage
accepted.x: Balika Samriddhi Yojana provides a post-birth grant and annual scholarships to girls from families living below the poverty line.
accepted.tq: Use the scheme-year and benefit together to avoid confusing similar girl-child schemes.

accepted.s: Dhanalakshmi scheme is correctly associated with which one of the following combinations?
o: 2000 — ICDS-based nutrition and life-skills training
2008 — conditional cash transfer linked to birth registration, immunisation, schooling and postponement of marriage beyond 18
1997 — post-birth grant and annual scholarships for BPL girls
2015 — small-savings account for education and marriage
accepted.x: Dhanalakshmi was introduced in 2008 as a conditional cash-transfer scheme linked to birth registration, immunisation, schooling and delaying marriage beyond 18 years.
accepted.tq: Match the year with the distinctive conditions attached to the scheme.

accepted.s:
With reference to Kishori Shakti Yojana, consider the following statements:
1. It was introduced in 2000.
2. It is based on the Integrated Child Development Services framework.
3. It focuses on nutrition, health and life-skills for adolescent girls.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Kishori Shakti Yojana was introduced in 2000 under the ICDS framework for the nutrition, health and life-skills development of adolescent girls.
accepted.tq: Check all components of a programme rather than relying only on its target group.

accepted.s: SABLA, or the Scheme for Adolescent Girls, is primarily concerned with which of the following?
o: Reimbursement of self-help-group loans
Nutrition, life-skills and health of adolescent girls
Savings accounts for girls below 10 years
Marriage assistance for poor minority brides
accepted.x: SABLA provides nutrition, life-skills and health-related support to adolescent girls and is now part of Poshan 2.0.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact beneficiary group and service package of the scheme.

accepted.s: SABLA has subsequently become part of which programme?
o: PMKVY 4.0
Mission Shakti
Poshan 2.0
Shakti Sadan
accepted.x: SABLA, the Scheme for Adolescent Girls, is now included within Poshan 2.0.
accepted.tq: Separate an existing component from schemes that merely serve a similar beneficiary group.

accepted.s: NAVYA, introduced for 2025–26, is implemented by which combination of ministries?
o: Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development and Ministry of Rural Development
Ministry of Education and Ministry of Labour and Employment
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship and Ministry of Women and Child Development
accepted.x: NAVYA is a joint initiative of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship and the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who launched or implements it?’ test to distinguish closely related ministries.

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes NAVYA?
1. It provides vocational training to girls aged 16–18 years.
2. It is delivered through PMKVY 4.0.
3. It covers 27 aspirational districts in 19 States.
4. It is meant exclusively for women above 45 years of age.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
o: 1, 2 and 3 only
1 and 4 only
2 and 3 only
accepted.x: NAVYA provides vocational training to girls aged 16–18 through PMKVY 4.0 in 27 aspirational districts across 19 States. It is not meant for women above 45 years.
accepted.tq: Find the single statement that reverses the scheme’s age group.

accepted.s: Under Talliki Vandanam, the annual assistance is payable to mothers of pupils studying in which classes, subject to the stated attendance condition?
o: Classes 1 to 8
Classes 1 to 10
Classes 6 to 12
Classes 1 to 5
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam provides ₹15,000 per year to mothers of pupils in Classes 1 to 10, subject to 75 per cent attendance.
accepted.tq: Read the beneficiary range and numerical condition together; both are potential traps.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly associated with Talliki Vandanam?
o: Marriage assistance for poor SC/ST/BC/minority brides
₹15,000 per year and 75 per cent attendance condition
₹18,750 per year without any attendance condition
Four instalments for reimbursement of SHG loans
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam provides ₹15,000 annually to eligible mothers, with a 75 per cent attendance condition, and was described as a restructured form of Amma Vodi.
accepted.tq: Compare the benefit amount and eligibility condition with those of neighbouring AP schemes.

accepted.s: YSR Cheyutha provides annual assistance of ₹18,750 to which group?
o: Women rescued from trafficking
Rural BPL women organised under DWCRA
BC, SC, ST and minority women aged 45–60 years
All women students in Classes 1 to 10
accepted.x: YSR Cheyutha, introduced in 2020, provides ₹18,750 annually to BC, SC, ST and minority women in the 45–60 age group.
accepted.tq: Use the combined social-category and age filter to identify the scheme.

accepted.s: YSR Aasara is associated with which of the following benefits?
o: Annual scholarships for girls of BPL families
Shelter for working women in urban areas
Financial support for vocational training of adolescent girls
Reimbursement of SHG loans outstanding as on 11 April 2019 in four instalments
accepted.x: YSR Aasara reimburses self-help-group loans outstanding as on 11 April 2019 through four instalments.
accepted.tq: Remember the cut-off date and instalment structure as the scheme’s distinguishing details.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding YSR Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa:
1. It was introduced in 2022.
2. It provides marriage assistance.
3. Its beneficiaries include poor SC, ST, BC and minority brides.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: YSR Kalyanamasthu/Shaadi Tohfa was introduced in 2022 and provides marriage assistance to poor brides belonging to SC, ST, BC and minority communities.
accepted.tq: Test the year, nature of assistance and beneficiary categories separately.

accepted.s: The Disha Bill passed by Andhra Pradesh in 2019 primarily sought to provide which of the following?
o: Loan reimbursement for women’s self-help groups
Fast-track trial of crimes against women
Free bus travel for women throughout the State
Universal maternity benefits for all women
accepted.x: The Disha Bill was an Andhra Pradesh legislative measure aimed at fast-track trials of crimes against women.
accepted.tq: Identify the legislative purpose rather than confusing a Bill with a welfare-delivery scheme.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the Disha Bill is correct?
o: It was withdrawn after receiving assent under the former IPC.
It never received Presidential assent; the IPC and CrPC provisions it sought to amend were replaced by the BNS and BNSS from 1 July 2024.
It was enacted by Parliament and amended only the CrPC.
It received Presidential assent and came into force in 2019.
accepted.x: The Disha Bill never received Presidential assent. The IPC and CrPC, which it sought to amend, were replaced by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita from 1 July 2024.
accepted.tq: Watch for the false legislative-status claim attached to an otherwise familiar law-and-order measure.

accepted.s: The One Stop Centres in Andhra Pradesh are intended to provide services to women through which administrative coverage?
o: Only the State capital
All 13 former districts
All 26 districts
Only districts containing Shakti Sadans
accepted.x: One Stop Centres are functioning in all 26 districts of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the exact administrative count instead of an older or reduced district figure.

accepted.s: The Women Helpline numbered 181 has been functioning in Andhra Pradesh since which year?
accepted.x: The Women Helpline 181 has been functioning in Andhra Pradesh since 2016.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the helpline’s starting year from the launch years of later AP schemes.

accepted.s: Swadhar Greh is intended primarily for which target group?
o: Working women requiring hostel accommodation
Rural women seeking savings facilities
Women in difficult circumstances
Adolescent girls requiring ICDS nutrition
accepted.x: Swadhar Greh is meant for women in difficult circumstances and has now been brought within Shakti Sadan.
accepted.tq: Identify the target group before considering the scheme’s institutional location.
accepted.sec: Shelter, livelihood and income schemes - target group

accepted.s: Ujjawala scheme, introduced in 2007, is primarily associated with which of the following?
o: Prevention of trafficking and rescue and rehabilitation of victims
Promotion of savings among rural women
Marriage assistance for poor brides
Skills for gainful employment of women
accepted.x: Ujjawala was introduced in 2007 for prevention of trafficking and for rescue and rehabilitation of trafficking victims. It has now been brought within Shakti Sadan.
accepted.tq: Separate an anti-trafficking scheme from livelihood and shelter schemes with overlapping beneficiaries.
accepted.sec: Shelter, livelihood and income schemes - target group

accepted.s: Shakti Sadan represents the merger of which two schemes?
o: DWCRA and Mahila Samriddhi Yojana
STEP and Swayam Siddha
SABLA and Kishori Shakti Yojana
Swadhar Greh and Ujjawala
accepted.x: Shakti Sadan is the merged institutional framework for Swadhar Greh and Ujjawala.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure merger pair and reject schemes that have different objectives.

accepted.s: STEP, introduced during 1986–87, was designed to promote which of the following?
o: Fast-track trials of crimes against women
Universal maternity assistance
Post-birth grants for girls
Skills for gainful employment of women
accepted.x: STEP, or Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women, was introduced in 1986–87 to develop skills for women’s gainful employment.
accepted.tq: Link the programme’s historical period with its employment-oriented purpose.
accepted.sec: Shelter, livelihood and income schemes - target group

accepted.s: Swayam Siddha is best described as a scheme for which of the following?
o: SHG-based holistic empowerment of women
Rescue and rehabilitation of trafficking victims
Hostel accommodation for working women
Conditional cash transfers for girls’ schooling
accepted.x: Swayam Siddha, introduced in 2001, promotes holistic women’s empowerment through self-help groups.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an empowerment model based on SHGs from schemes providing a single benefit.
accepted.sec: Shelter, livelihood and income schemes - target group

accepted.s: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana, introduced in 1993, seeks to promote which one of the following among rural women?
o: Shelter in difficult circumstances
The habit of saving
Nutrition under ICDS
Vocational training through PMKVY
accepted.x: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana was introduced in 1993 to encourage the savings habit among rural women.
accepted.tq: Use the beneficiary group and the single core objective to avoid scheme substitution.
accepted.sec: Shelter, livelihood and income schemes - target group

accepted.s: Working Women Hostel, introduced during 1972–73, is now known as which of the following?
o: Shakti Sadan
Swadhar Greh
One Stop Centre
Sakhi Niwas
accepted.x: The Working Women Hostel scheme, introduced during 1972–73 for working women, is now known as Sakhi Niwas.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a renamed accommodation facility from shelter and crisis-support institutions.
accepted.sec: Shelter, livelihood and income schemes - target group

accepted.s: The reported rape conviction rate has remained approximately within which range, leading to calls for extending fast-track courts?
o: 18–20 per cent
10–12 per cent
45–50 per cent
27–28 per cent
accepted.x: The rape conviction rate is reported to have remained around 27–28 per cent, prompting demands for more fast-track courts and stronger standards.
accepted.tq: Use the narrow reported range rather than a rounded or exaggerated percentage.

accepted.s: Which of the following reforms has been demanded in relation to One Stop Centres and shelters?
o: Extension of fast-track courts and national minimum standards for OSCs and shelters
Abolition of fast-track courts and decentralisation of shelters
Replacement of OSCs by SHGs in every district
Restriction of shelters to women above 45 years
accepted.x: The stated demands include extending fast-track courts and establishing national minimum standards for One Stop Centres and shelters.
accepted.tq: Connect the identified institutional shortcomings with the specific reform proposals.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Andhra Pradesh demographic and policy context mentioned in relation to women’s welfare?
o: Talliki Vandanam is a hostel scheme and the total fertility rate is approximately 0.7.
Talliki Vandanam is an anti-trafficking scheme and the total fertility rate is approximately 2.7.
Talliki Vandanam is an unconditional pension and Andhra Pradesh’s total fertility rate is approximately 3.7.
Talliki Vandanam is a conditional cash transfer and Andhra Pradesh’s total fertility rate is approximately 1.7.
accepted.x: Talliki Vandanam is described as a conditional cash transfer, while Andhra Pradesh’s total fertility rate is approximately 1.7.
accepted.tq: Match the welfare instrument with the correct demographic indicator instead of a similar-sounding scheme.
